title: Web Store Listing
meta: A clear Chrome Web Store page with a strong title, screenshots and plain permission notes. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Chrome Web Store listing written and designed
overview: Your store page is often the only thing a person sees before deciding to install. We rewrite your title, short description and long description in plain words with the terms people search for, design clean screenshots and a small promo tile, and explain each permission so visitors feel safe. We follow the store listing rules and never copy other extensions. You receive text and images ready to paste in.

pkgs.blurb: A sharper title and descriptions, ready to paste into your listing.
Text plus a set of clean screenshots that show the value.
A complete listing refresh with visuals and a short video script.

faq: Will this improve my ranking in the store?
No one can. We write clear text with the terms people search for and show the product honestly, which is what the store favors. Results depend on your extension and competition.
What do you need from me?
Your extension name, a short description of what it does, who it is for and the permissions it uses. A link to the current listing helps us see what to improve.
No. All text is written fresh for your extension. We may study how others describe similar tools to understand search terms, but we never reuse their words or screenshots.
Can you upload the changes for me?
Yes on Premium, if you add us as a collaborator on your developer account. On other packages you paste the text and upload the images yourself, and we send a short guide.
